# unibook

> unibook is a free study site for 3rd-year English (Licence, Semester 5) students at the Department of English, University Hassiba Benbouali of Chlef, Algeria. Lessons are rebuilt as short bites with quizzes and flashcards. Author: Bennafla Ridha.

This file lists every published lesson with a link to its Markdown copy. All lessons in one file: https://roboticchlef02-dev.github.io/llms-full.txt. Lessons are simplified from the teachers' handouts; the teacher is named on each lesson and the handout is the authority.

1 lesson published in 1 module of 10.

## Civilization, Culture and Interculturality

- [Lecture 1: Civilization, Culture and Interculturality](https://roboticchlef02-dev.github.io/civilization/lecture/01-civilization-culture-interculturality.md): How culture, civilization and interculturality differ, and how the United Kingdom took shape from 1707 to 1921.
